title: Daring Rakhwala
desc: An intoxicated dog bites a security guard, unleashes a zombie outbreak. A traffic officer takes up the responsibility to find the antidote.

title: Veergati
desc: Ajay finds it difficult to work in a corrupt society. Hence, he begins to gamble and soon finds himself helping the prostitutes who are exploited by Ekka Seth.

title: Mere Sajna Saath Nibhana
desc: Kanhaiya, a poor street performer, falls in love with Chanchal, a wealthy woman. He convinces his mother to ask for her hand in marriage, but things take a turn when Chanchal's father insults her.

title: Koyla
desc: Silenced by a piece of smouldering coal in childhood, Shankar endures a life of slavery until love compels him to seek his voice, freedom, and long-overdue revenge.

title: Ram Lakhan
desc: Ram, an upright police officer, and his brother Lakhan, a playboy, vow vengeance when they learn that their father was killed by two wicked tricksters.
